checks: Exact-real historical two-rate family retains the rounded historical products as exact dyadics; no equality with the older dyadic center rates is inferred.
Pure third directional and mixed first derivatives propagate through the explicit simultaneous gradient. Product and tanh third derivatives have correct combinatorial factors.
Augmented root is (G-x,(M+I)q,(q^Tq-1)/2); its q block is M+I, with q fixed in mixed state/parameter differentiation.
Invertibility of the transposed bordered M+I system establishes an algebraically simple minus-one multiplier and p^Tq=1 at the root.
Orbit derivative is -(M-I)^(-1)G_s. The multiplier derivative includes both orbit motion and direct variation of both layer rates.
Cubic coefficient includes the quadratic resolvent correction; it is not the raw third derivative alone. Formula checked against Kuznetsov primary lecture pp11-12.
Deflation M+q p^T replaces the critical minus-one multiplier by zero; an interval power norm below one proves attracting complement.
Proper divisors are excluded in the full state. Neutral flip itself is not called attracting; finite detuning and connection to the center are separate claims.
All full gates must pass before criticality or doubled-side labels are given.
